Response Readiness Api V1 Health Ready Get

get.description:
Metadata for one keyframe plus its neighbouring keyframes.

One request per verify panel: the neighbour thumbnails are then plain
`/frames/{frame_id}` reads and the clip preview is `/stream#t=pts_sec`.

Stream the source video for in-place playback.

Seek on the client: `<video src=".../stream#t=12.5">`. FileResponse honours
Range requests, so the browser pulls only the bytes around that timestamp
instead of the file, and nothing is decoded or re-encoded server side.
Metadata and sampled-frame markers for the full verification studio.
Decode one exact original-video frame for submission verification.

AsrEvidence.title: AsrEvidence
AsrEvidence.description: The speech segment that produced an ASR-only frame result.

EventCandidate.title: EventCandidate
EventCandidate.description: One frame proposed for one TRAKE event.

EventHit.title: EventHit
EventHit.description:
The frame chosen for an event, plus the ones it beat.

`alternates` are bounded by the neighbouring events' chosen frames, so an
operator swapping one in cannot produce an out-of-order submission.

youtube_id.title: Youtube Id
youtube_id.description: YouTube id of the source upload, for previewing at `pts_sec` via an embed instead of range-reading the local mp4. None when `media-info/<video_id>.json` is missing a watch URL.

FrameContext.title: FrameContext
FrameContext.description:
Everything the verify panel shows about one retrieved keyframe.

`frame_id` is `original_frame_id` — what a submission reports. It is not a
key: two keyframes of the same video can share one, so `keyframe_n` is the
identity and the first match wins here.

asr_enabled.description: Toggle the ASR overlap bonus for this query.

asr_weight.title: Asr Weight
asr_weight.description: Share of a frame's score the best overlapping segment adds.

asr_dense_weight.title: Asr Dense Weight
asr_dense_weight.description: Weight of the dense (semantic) half of the speech search.

asr_sparse_weight.title: Asr Sparse Weight
asr_sparse_weight.description: Weight of the lexical (BM25) half of the speech search.

retrieval_mode.title: Retrieval Mode
retrieval_mode.description: Explicit retrieval source. Omit to keep the configured default and legacy asr_enabled behaviour. ASR-only is supported by KIS/Q&A only.

NeighbourFrame.title: NeighbourFrame
NeighbourFrame.description: A keyframe next to the one being verified, ordered by frame index.

QaCandidate.title: QaCandidate
QaCandidate.description:
A frame plus the answer the operator read off it.

`answer` is human input - no VQA model produces it - so it arrives with
whatever a paste carried.

QaSearchRequest.title: QaSearchRequest
QaSearchRequest.description:
Same retrieval as KIS: find the moment, the operator reads it.

There is no `question` field. It was never encoded — SigLIP2 scores a
caption against an image and "what colour is the bike?" describes no
image — and no VQA model is wired in, so nothing downstream could use it.
The operator answers off the frame and types it into the submission.

rewritten_queries.title: Rewritten Queries
rewritten_queries.description: The English forms the rewriting step encoded against the image space: [description] for KIS/QA, [overview, *events] for TRAKE. See cleaned_queries for the speech form. Null when rewriting was off or failed, in which case the query was searched exactly as typed.

cleaned_queries.title: Cleaned Queries
cleaned_queries.description: The original-language forms with retrieval instructions removed, searched against speech transcripts. Null when rewriting was off or failed.

TimelineKeyframe.description: One sampled frame exposed on the full-video verification timeline.

video_ids.title: Video Ids
video_ids.description: Search only these videos, skipping video selection entirely. For an operator who already found the video with a KIS query.

max_gap_sec.title: Max Gap Sec
max_gap_sec.description: Widest gap in seconds between consecutive events. 0 disables the check; None uses the configured default.
